description:
A teaching assistant is preparing a seminar on 'The Origins of Artificial Intelligence'. Your task is to organize key historical papers and generate a reading packet.

1. Create a new collection named 'AI History Seminar'.
2. Find and add these 4 papers to the collection:
   - 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' (Turing, 1950)
   - 'On Computable Numbers...' (Turing, 1936)
   - 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon, 1948)
   - 'Recursive Functions of Symbolic Expressions...' (McCarthy, 1960)
3. Add a child note to the paper 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' with the text: 'Essential reading: Discusses the Imitation Game.'
4. Generate a Zotero Report from the 'AI History Seminar' collection (Right-click collection > Generate Report from Collection).
5. Save the report as an HTML file to '/home/ga/Documents/ai_seminar_report.html'.
